method: Individually viewed actual full v3 PNG with view_image; compared with rejected v1/v2 findings and authorized upright composition.

Monochrome contours and clear central silhouette remain consistent with collection style. Fine hatching is secondary to readable chair, hands and faces. Actual web/PDF reduction still requires production review.
